scope: Implement the live visual audit findings without adding or changing experience claims
changes: Self-hosted Aeonik Pro Light, Regular and Bold replace Source Sans 3 and Newsreader. No synthetic cuts or external font requests.
Destination labels are shared across home search, Compass, local discovery and destination pages. Regression coverage checks publishing-order independence.
Home destination counts reflect the actual target page, not the shorter authored sequence.
Photo links have accessible names. Credits wrap and no longer collide with home destination calls to action.
Home destination photographs precede optional local discovery controls. London uses the existing credited Borough Market photograph.
Empty journey onboarding offers photographed destinations and three clear steps. Export tools wait for a real draft. Existing notes-only and named drafts remain accessible.
Compass, New, destinations and Journal reduce introductory friction. Filters remain available through disclosures.
Collections start with up to six geographically varied guides, with the full remaining catalogue available progressively. Timed by place uses a tide-related documentary cover.
Mobile hero grid no longer expands beyond a 320px viewport. Tablet navigation actions align to the right.
